justification: Image A depicts a carved memorial stone with interlace border, a mounted horse-and-rider figure, and a ship with figures beneath, all rendered in a naturalistic-schematic linear carving style; image B depicts an abstract painted composition of concentric-circle rosettes, a stick-like anthropomorphic figure with splayed legs, and straight banded lines. There is no overlap in the specific motifs (no horse, ship, or interlace in B; no concentric rosette or stick-figure in A), so the depicted iconography shares nothing beyond the trivial fact that both include a humanoid figure, which is too generic to count as a real correspondence.
